title: Animation Ideas: Cartoon, Anime, 3D and Pixel Art
summary: 12 animation ideas to borrow, from hand-drawn cartoons to painted films and tiny 3D worlds, each shown with the real AI short a filmmaker made in Flick.
body_markdown:
### What are some good animation ideas?


Good animation ideas use something a camera cannot film, such as a whale swimming over a city, a dragon painted onto a wall that can fly away, or a tiny knight crossing a bedroom. Keep to one character and one clear want.


### What are easy animation ideas for beginners?


The easiest animation ideas have one character, one place and one action, such as a toy robot crawling to its charger or a fox reaching for a light. A single gag in under 30 seconds is a good first project.


### How do I come up with animation ideas?


Start with one "what if" about something ordinary, such as a chef who never looks down or a drawing that wants to meet someone, then ask what becomes possible once it is animated. Keep the result to one sentence.


### What can I animate for a short film?


A short film can animate anything with one clear want, such as a toy, an animal, a memory or a painting. Small casts and one location suit a short, because fewer designs have to stay consistent across every shot.


### What are good 2D animation ideas?


Good 2D animation ideas rely on clear shapes and exaggeration, such as a space cook hunting for a missing spice or a kitchen overrun by mice. Flat color and bold poses read quickly, which suits comedy and stories for children.


### What are good 3D animation ideas?


Good 3D animation ideas play with scale and material, such as a tiny robot crossing a wooden floor or a traveler walking on clouds made of cotton. Small characters in large, detailed spaces show off depth and light.


### Can you make an animated short with AI on your own?


Yes. In Flick one person can write the premise, design characters and places, generate shots and voices, and cut the film on one canvas. Every film behind the ideas on this page was made on a Flick canvas.


### Can I use these animation ideas for my own film?


Yes, a premise is free to borrow as a starting point, but the films themselves, their characters and their images belong to the filmmakers who made them, so make the idea your own.
